title: Sage ai_schedule record
description: A ai_schedule record (AIScheduleRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another ai_schedule record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

items.description: A task: its name ("FaceTarget"), or { "task": "Wait", "seconds": 1.5 } for one that takes a number.

tasks+.description: Adds to "tasks": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

items.description: A task: its name ("FaceTarget"), or { "task": "Wait", "seconds": 1.5 } for one that takes a number.

tasks-.description: Removes these from "tasks" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

items.description: A task: its name ("FaceTarget"), or { "task": "Wait", "seconds": 1.5 } for one that takes a number.

interrupts+.description: Adds to "interrupts": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

interrupts-.description: Removes these from "interrupts" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).
